releases.name: 鹈鹕巡检 · Pelican Monitor 2.6.2
releases.body:
Artwork titles now use the dashboard language in the gallery, latest output, previews and run details. The test prompt has five display languages and a disclosure for the exact text sent to the model. Open run details to see the original artwork title. New titles without a translation receive a dated label. Magpie's sidebar and breadcrumb keep the host interface language.

监测页会翻译作品标题和固定提示词。可在提示词下查看实际发送的原文，也可在运行详情中查看作品的原始标题。喜鹊侧栏和顶部名称继续跟随喜鹊的界面语言。

releases.name: 鹈鹕巡检 · Pelican Monitor 2.6.1
releases.body:
The dashboard now includes a user guide that switches language together with the page title. Magpie's plugin details can load the bundled English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese or German README. GitHub and npm readers can choose a language at the top of the README.

监测页的名称和使用说明会随右上角的语言选择一起切换。喜鹊插件详情按喜鹊的界面语言选择 README。插件列表使用双语名称「鹈鹕巡检 · Pelican Monitor」。

releases.name: 鹈鹕巡检 2.6.0
releases.body:
鹈鹕巡检 2.6.0 支持简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語和 Deutsch。监测页默认跟随系统语言，可在右上角切换。

休息日抽样现在可跟随语言地区或手动选择地区。在「休息日日历」逐月点选日期，可把单日设为工作日或休息日；保存后对全部账号生效。定时检测和免打扰使用运行喜鹊的电脑所在时区。

Pelican Monitor now offers five interface languages. Rest-day sampling follows a regional calendar with editable dates. Checks and quiet hours use the host computer’s local time zone. Calendar data ships with the plugin for offline use.

releases.name: 鹈鹕巡检 2.5.2
releases.body: 喜鹊的 Codex 账号巡检页面，支持免打扰、按中国工作日历抽样和动画归档。可通过喜鹊 CLI 安装：magpie plugin add github:fengcyborg/magpie-pelican-hour 。附带与本次源码对应的 npm 格式安装包。
